en.name: EPF / UAN Services (Employees' Provident Fund)
en.description: Mandatory provident fund, pension (EPS), and insurance (EDLI) for organised-sector employees; managed via UAN.
en.eligibility: Employees with basic wage up to statutory limit in establishments covered under EPF Act.
en.benefits: Retirement corpus with interest, pension, withdrawal/advance facilities, transfer on job change.
application_steps: Activate UAN on EPFO member portal / UMANG.
Seed Aadhaar, bank, PAN via KYC.
Track claim status; amount credited to bank.
faqs: How do I check my PF balance?
How do I check PF balance?
How do I transfer PF on job change?
